cards.title: OpenAI Files Countersuit Against Apple
cards.body: OpenAI has responded to Apple's summer lawsuit with its own countersuit, accusing Apple of unlawfully pressuring vendors. The legal battle escalates tensions between the two tech giants.

cards.title: Sakana AI Strengthens Japan's AI Independence
cards.body: Sakana AI's CEO emphasizes that homegrown models extend beyond national security to boost Japan's industrial competitiveness. The company aims to develop sovereign AI capabilities.

cards.title: Nvidia Pauses Southeast Asia Chip Shipments
cards.body: Nvidia has instructed manufacturing partners to halt server shipments to Malaysia, Singapore, Thailand, and Indonesia. The move aligns with U.S. efforts to restrict AI chips from reaching China.

cards.title: S&P Considers Downgrading Nvidia's Credit
cards.body: S&P may lower Nvidia's credit rating to AA- citing governance and 'key man' risks. The potential downgrade reflects concerns about the company's leadership structure.

cards.title: OpenAI Merges Chat and Work Experiences
cards.body: OpenAI will introduce a unified usage meter across ChatGPT as it combines Chat and Work platforms. Heavy users may encounter limits sooner under the new system.

cards.title: Anthropic CEO Defends Human Control Stance
cards.body: Anthropic's Dario Amodei dismissed accusations that he favors surrendering human agency to AI as 'absurd.' He pushed back against rivals as AI companies automate research and development.

cards.title: New York Bans AI Chatbot Toys
cards.body: New York has implemented a five-year ban on AI chatbot toys following safety concerns from Common Sense Media research. The ban addresses risks including inappropriate content exposure and emotional development impacts.

cards.title: Character.AI Faces Data Privacy Challenge
cards.body: State attorneys general challenge Character.ai's bankruptcy auction plan that includes private chat data from 21 million U.S. accounts. The proposal raises concerns for over 2.1 million registered minor accounts.

cards.title: AI Data Center Construction Slows
cards.body: Nvidia's strict financing requirements are creating delays and higher debt costs for neoclouds building AI infrastructure. The company prioritizes completed facilities with land and power over early-stage pitches.

cards.title: Amazon and Meta Negotiate Muse Deal
cards.body: Amazon and Meta are discussing terms to end a two-month blockade of AI agent Muse. A potential agreement could restore functionality to the platform.

cards.title: Jensen Huang Faces Megaspeed Investigation
cards.body: Investigators scrutinize what Nvidia knew about where Megaspeed chips ended up and whether Huang's personal relationship with a Megaspeed executive affected oversight. Questions persist about corporate governance during the period.

cards.title: Yale Economist Criticizes Nvidia's Leadership
cards.body: Yale's Jeffrey Sonnenfeld warns that Jensen Huang's return as CEO and board member could harm U.S. industrial strength rather than strengthen it. He highlights mounting lawsuits and potential director liability.

cards.title: Jensen Huang Rejects Succession Planning
cards.body: Nvidia's founder maintains that succession planning creates unnecessary hierarchy despite recent leadership turmoil. His stance is striking given the company's recent weeks without established succession protocols.

cards.title: Jensen Huang Addresses Staff in Meeting
cards.body: Nvidia's founder apologized to employees and expressed gratitude for a second chance to lead the company. Huang disclosed he's attending therapy to address workplace concerns.

cards.title: Advanced AI Agents Struggle with Basics
cards.body: A new benchmark reveals that even top AI models fail to reliably complete everyday tasks safely. As personal AI assistants gain adoption, limitations raise concerns about real-world reliability.

cards.title: Walmart Integrates Black Friday with Muse
cards.body: Walmart now enables customers to shop Black Friday deals through Meta's AI agent Muse. The partnership expands retail integration with AI-powered shopping experiences.

cards.title: Maple Raises $5.3M for Data Privacy
cards.body: Maple's encrypted AI architecture prevents even the company from accessing users' private data. The startup raised $5.3M to build privacy-first AI products.

cards.title: Anthropic Shares Fall Below IPO Price
cards.body: Anthropic's post-IPO stock slump signals potential headwinds for AI startup valuations. The decline raises concerns about investor confidence in the sector.

cards.title: Jensen Huang Violated Nvidia Code
cards.body: Jensen Huang broke Nvidia's code of conduct, with potential consequences for company culture. Corporate codes typically reflect leadership values and accountability standards.

cards.title: GTA VI Success Challenges AI Efficiency
cards.body: Grand Theft Auto VI's record-breaking launch on the same day as Anthropic's IPO demonstrates the enduring value of painstaking human creativity. The game's success questions whether pure efficiency drives cultural impact.

cards.title: AI Strains America's Open Records Systems
cards.body: AI has intensified investor interest in public records, overwhelming small-town clerks managing open records requests. Towns like Panton, Vermont are struggling to keep up with the volume of data requests.

cards.title: Data Centers Building Their Own Gas Plants
cards.body: AI data centers are bypassing long grid-connection waits by building private natural gas power plants. This behind-the-meter approach sidesteps decade-long approval processes for grid connections.

cards.title: AI Could Keep Us Dependent on Natural Gas
cards.body: Rising electricity demands from AI infrastructure are driving a US natural gas boom. Data centers are becoming major drivers of continued fossil fuel reliance.

cards.title: Next-Generation Bionic Hands Feel Again
cards.body: New prosthetics wired to nerves enable users to sense pressure and handle delicate objects. This advancement combines AI-driven sensory processing with neural interfaces.

cards.title: AI May Transform Theoretical Physics
cards.body: Machine learning is poised to fundamentally change how theoretical physicists conduct research and modeling. AI tools could accelerate discovery and reshape the discipline.

cards.title: Etsy Clarifies AI Policy After Backlash
cards.body: The platform updated its AI terms following seller concerns about generative AI usage. Etsy addressed community worries about AI-generated content on the marketplace.
